headline: Within NAAMP, recent-rain acoustic change is best described structurally as strong recruitment across activity thresholds followed by unusually coherent but geographically compact multi-stop expression of recruited species. The proximal environmental mediator is not identified.

route_new_species_count.interpretation: Distinct route-new species count is not itself unusually high relative to the uniform null.

extra_stop_spread.conclusion: Spread excess remains after conditioning on how many distinct route-new species were recruited.

local_contiguity.conclusion: Recruited species occupy adjacent stop sequences more often than expected even for their excess number of occupied stops.

geographic_compactness.conclusion: The same recruited species occur at more stops but over more compact sub-route spans than expected.

physical_stop_relocation.evidence: 98.49% of pairs retain all ten SiteIDs; stable-site subset retains 93.05% boundary crossing and rejects both primary nulls.

weak_call_detection_only.evidence: 87.1% of activation slope is from 0->CallingIndex 2/3; same-observer and detection-quality-adjusted analyses retain positive CI-supported strong activation.

immediate_only_rain_pulse.evidence: Strong activation remains positive in 0-1 and 2-3 day wet-recency strata; 4-7 day estimate is also positive but imprecise. Prefixed immediate-vs-delayed gate was nonestimable because delayed sample was below minimum.

mapped_hydroperiod.interpretation: Long-term pulse-limited wetland context shows partial directional evidence for gains but does not explain strong chorus activation under the prefixed primary test.

jrc_surface_water.reason: Prefixed coverage gate failed: 21.8% of pair-used coordinate sites had a JRC surface-water pixel within 200 m; informative routes=298 below required 300.

universality.naamp_internal: Strong activation survives 21/21 leave-one-state-out analyses and taxonomic contributions are diffuse. Local-cluster route-split replication is pending.
universality.cross_continental: Not established. AnuraSet INCT20955 and INCT41 did not satisfy the prefixed threshold-dominance replication rule, and available Australia/NPS datasets do not support a direct effort-complete spatial-matrix replication.
universality.authorized_wording: general within the sampled NAAMP domain; not a universal or continent-general law

ecological_interpretation.strongest: Recent rain is associated with activation of previously silent species x stop cells into overlapping/full choruses, and newly recruited route-level species then appear repeatedly in spatially contiguous, sub-route clusters more than expected from their number alone.
plausible_but_unidentified: local breeding-site opportunity or wetland-complex activation
weakened: simple attraction to an already-active chorus
mapped NWI hydroperiod as the sole mediator

pending: Disjoint-route replication of conditional local contiguity.
Robust species-concentration sensitivity under same-observer plus same-physical-stop restriction.
Optional high-resolution local precipitation test only after a fully prefixed computational sampling design.
